channel.title: The Grant Desk - Game Design, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Game Design, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Game Design grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Slamdance Film Festival 2027: DIG (Digital, Interactive and Gaming)
    https://slamdance.com/festival-submit/
    Slamdance · deadline 06 Oct 2026 · Festival exhibition at Slamdance in Los Angeles. DIG welcomes interactive documentaries, VR/AR, experiential installations, and genre-bending games. Entry fees: USD 60 regular, USD 70 late, USD 90 extended/final.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 4 new Game Design grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• UK Global Screen Fund: International Distribution, Video Game Release Funding
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/funding-support-international-activity/uk-global-screen-fund/uk-global-screen-fund-ukgsf-international-distribution-video-game-release-funding
    British Film Institute (UK Global Screen Fund, backed by DCMS) · deadline Closed 14 Aug 2026 · Non-recoupable grant towards international marketing and release activity; the award range is not published on the fund page. A cap of GBP 625,000 applies across all UKGSF strands per organisation over any three-year period. No application fee.
  • Game Design Emerging Talents: Production
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/game-design-emerging-talents-production
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 50,000, requiring a matching grant of equal value from own or third-party funding. No application fee.
  • Game Design Emerging Talents: Post-Production
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/game-design-emerging-talents-post-production
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 20,000, plus potential individual coaching. No application fee.
  • Game Design Emerging Talents: She Got Game (Switzerland)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/game-design-emerging-talents-she-got-game
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · CHF 3,000 toward prototype/demo production, plus mentoring, community access, and potential trade-fair access; up to CHF 250 per week childcare support for international events. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Game Design grant - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• PLAY26 Creative Gaming Festival: Open Call for Games & Playful Media Works
    https://www.playfestival.de/en/play26-submissions-are-open
    PLAY - Creative Gaming Festival · deadline Closed 28 Jun 2026 · Exhibition and awards opportunity, NOT a paid grant: selected works are showcased to an international festival audience. Awards include the Most Creative Game Award and an Audience Award (all games in the festival exhibition are eligible, voted on by festival visitors). No artist fee is stated.
